tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Tailwind: bg-background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, card and popover (18:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and raised panel background. Tailwind: bg-card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside a card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Background of popovers, menus, the open Select and tooltips.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside a popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The PUI brand color (deep teal). Primary action, active item, links. As text it reads on background and card (6.4:1 / 8.9:1). One primary action per area.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (6.1:1 / 8:1). Dark text in the dark theme: never hard-code white on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and surfaces. Tailwind: bg-secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet backgrounds: table row hover, Skeleton, empty areas.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, metadata. Reads on background, card and muted (≥5.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlight for menu items, ghost buttons and selected rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent (10:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. As text it reads on background (5.3:1 / 6.6:1).

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive (≥5.3:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and confirmation states. Always pair it with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending states. Always pair it with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on warning.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Decorative: carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Field borders (Input, Select, Checkbox, Switch off). Strong enough to reach 3:1.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid + 2px offset on background. ≥6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Regular Liquid Glass (60% fill, strong blur): controls that float over page and card surfaces, such as secondary, outline and ghost buttons and the tab track. Utility: `glass`. Text keeps ≥4.5:1 over the neutral surfaces; over color or media use `glass-strong` or `glass-clear`.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Dense glass for floating layers that carry text: menus, popovers, the selected tab, hover on glass buttons. Utility: `glass-strong`. Text keeps ≥4.5:1 over neutral, brand and chart colors.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass for controls over photos and video. Always on a `bg-glass-dim` layer, with `text-glass-clear-foreground` icons and bold labels. Utility: `glass-clear`.

tokens.name: glass-dim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer (50% black) behind clear glass, so its white icons and bold labels keep ≥3:1 even over white media.

tokens.name: glass-clear-foreground
tokens.usage: Icons and bold labels on clear glass.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline edge that catches light on glass. Decorative: field and control borders keep `input`.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: What `glass` and `glass-strong` become with Reduce transparency or Increase contrast.

tokens.name: glass-clear-solid
tokens.usage: What `glass-clear` becomes with Reduce transparency or Increase contrast.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (the brand).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 ("other").

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Sidebar item hover.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar borders.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Sidebar focus.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. One per screen. Tailwind: text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Main sections. Tailwind: text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Group and dialog titles. Tailwind: text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Track sales and your team in one place.
styles.usage: Page intro in muted-foreground. Tailwind: text-xl text-muted-foreground.

styles.name: p
styles.sample: The report compares this quarter with the previous one.
styles.usage: Running text on content pages. Tailwind: leading-7.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: UI default: buttons, fields, tables, menus. Tailwind: text-sm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels and "small" text. Tailwind: text-sm font-medium leading-none.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, captions, keyboard shortcuts. Tailwind: text-xs.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on muted. Tailwind: font-mono text-sm font-semibold.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Aligned numbers in tables (tabular-nums), IDs, hashes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: gap-1. Icon + text inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: gap-2. Icon + text in buttons; toolbar items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: gap-3 / px-3. Horizontal padding of Input and Select.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: p-4 / gap-4. Alert padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: p-6 / gap-6. Card padding, space between card sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: gap-8. Between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: py-12. Between large page sections.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base (--radius = 0.5rem). The other radii derive from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: rounded-sm. Checkbox, Badge, small items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: rounded-md. Menu and list items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: rounded-lg. Input, Select, Textarea, Skeleton.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: rounded-xl. Alert, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: rounded-2xl. Card and large glass panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: rounded-full. Buttons, badges, tab tracks, switch, avatar: Liquid Glass capsules.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Input, outline Button, Select.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popover, DropdownMenu.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog, Sheet.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass light and depth: a bright top rim, a faint bottom rim, a hairline all around and a soft drop shadow. Tailwind: shadow-glass. Every glass control and every solid button uses it.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind glass (with 200% saturation).
